note: Named people of a career's story who have a look of their own instead of their job's stock clothes (QST-014, ADR-0059; ART_DIRECTION C7, C9). Keyed by resident id. Values are the designer's (World/rules/designer.json: height in metres, build, the face controls; colours as palette names or linear RGB) and the ones that say age (ADR-0059): age 0 to 1 (lines at the brow, the eyes and from nose to mouth; paler lips), dress_len (a dress's hem in metres over the ground: garment 'dress', bare legs below it). Each look is copied from the Blender design it names, which the owner approved; a change here is a change to that design, shown to the owner first.
